notes.title: Patch #2
notes.content:
Hello!
We focused on:

- loading window not loading a save file when clicked
- fixed a bug where the game would crash when using an empty slot for a new game.
- fixing minor hidden errors within the game

If you encounter any bugs please do inform us!

-AM
